author: Kieran
html: Very insightful and thought provoking post. It is humbling to be reminded of the struggles faced by millions of people in less developed countries, and the relative insignificance of much of our own worries. I stumbled on your journey yesterday and spent much of my morning learning about it (and avoiding doing actual work in my office job). I admire you for embarking on such a journey and for the openness you have shown along the way. Good luck

author: Basile
html: Thank you for your appreciation, I really loved your comment!

author: nitu
html: Reading about your encounter with Nader and a peep into his life gave me a reality check of things we take for granted in our lives. Thankyou Basil for sharing this experience . looking forward to reading many more.
